Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a sales and use tax exemption for recovered wood waste boiler equipment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a sales and use tax exemption for recovered woodwaste boiler equipment used in steam production; adding a new sectionto chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 shall not apply to: (a) Sales of recovered wood waste boiler equipment used primarilyin the production or generation of steam for sale to be used in itsoriginal state primarily for: (i) Sterilizing tangible personalproperty; (ii) heating water or other tangible personal property; and(iii) heating structures; (b) Sales of repair parts and replacement parts for recovered woodwaste boiler equipment described in (a) of this subsection; or (c) Sales of or charges made for labor and services rendered inrespect to installing, repairing, cleaning, altering, or improvingrecovered wood waste boiler equipment described in (a) of thissubsection. p. 1 HB 3114 (2) A person taking the exemption under this section must keeprecords necessary for the department to verify eligibility under thissection. This exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller shall retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) The definitions in this subsection (3) apply throughout thissection, unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Recovered wood waste" means discarded wood, such as wood frompallets and crate materials, shredded wood waste from land clearing,saw dust and wood trimmings from cabinet shops, and wood waste from sawmills. (b) "Recovered wood waste boiler equipment" means recovered woodwastefired boilers; recovered wood waste storage silos located on thesite of a recovered wood wastefired boiler plant; indoor coveredconveyers to transport recovered wood waste to a recovered wood wastefired boiler; and recovered wood wastefired boiler plant emissionscontrol equipment, including multicyclone dust collectors andelectrostatic precipitators.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse of: (a) Recovered wood waste boiler equipment used primarily in theproduction or generation of steam for sale to be used in its originalstate primarily for: (i) Sterilizing tangible personal property; (ii)heating water or other tangible personal property; and (iii) heatingstructures; (b) Repair parts and replacement parts for recovered wood wasteboiler equipment described in (a) of this subsection; or (c) Labor and services rendered in respect to installing,repairing, cleaning, altering, or improving recovered wood waste boilerequipment described in (a) of this subsection. (2) For the purposes of this section, the definitions in section 1of this act apply.
